title: Emphasis on Subject
theory:
 When a pronoun comes after the verb "to be" (is, am, are, was, were, be, been, being), we use
   the subjective case of pronouns.
		 Subjective Pronouns: I, He, She, We, They, Who
    Structure
 Subject + Verb "to be" + Subjective Pronoun
       Examples

mcqs.question: It will be us?
mcqs.explanation: It will be us should be replaced with It will be we of

mcqs.question: Was it?
mcqs.explanation: her who did it should be replaced with she who did it

mcqs.question: It is I,?

options.a: / not my friend, who has got

mcqs.explanation: who has got should be replaced with who have got

mcqs.question: The real heroes of the rescue?

options.b: / without caring for their own safety.

mcqs.explanation: them who should be replaced with those who of use will be,

mcqs.question: The scientist who presented the groundbreaking?
mcqs.explanation: him who should be replaced with he who of use will be,

mcqs.question: It was undoubtedly me?
mcqs.explanation: me who should be replaced with I who of use will be,

mcqs.question: It was ......... who completed the entire project before the deadline.
The winners of the competition were ......... who had practised day and night.
It is ......... who am responsible for maintaining discipline in the classroom.
Was it ......... who informed the principal about the incident yesterday?
